method: Unmodified source fonts; offline inferred centerlines with separately named stroke studies.
modified: Stroke order is heuristic, not recovered human ductus. Short shared branches can be retraced; no glyph outlines or typeset reveals are drawn.

generation.method: Rasterized original outlines, Zhang-Suen medial-axis thinning, source-component preservation, graph traversal and polyline simplification.
generation.sourceMetricReconstruction: Only Italianno underscore: its mapped source glyph is empty, so its own advance and post-table underline metrics provide an explicitly attributed centerline.
generation.compactMarks: Only compact filled source components without a traversable skeleton use an attributed short interior principal-axis stroke. Other failures abort generation.
generation.newStudySizing: Natural script/print scales are capped by all 94 glyphs’ vertical extents to leave at least eight writing-canvas units between lines. Existing selected study metrics remain exact.
